title: Private access · request flow
subtitle: Workstation name resolution is separate from Kubernetes service DNS.
description: A workstation hosts entry maps an internal hostname to the current node LAN IP. HTTP reaches K3s ServiceLB and Traefik, which selects a Kubernetes Service and ready endpoints by Ingress hostname. No public tunnel is active.

nodes.title: Node → K3s ServiceLB → Traefik
lines: Request reaches port 80; Ingress matches the HTTP hostname

nodes.title: Kubernetes Service → ready application endpoints
lines: Grafana / Prometheus become available after monitoring bootstrap

notes.text: Each accessing device needs resolution and LAN connectivity. No LAN DNS server is installed.
Cluster-local service names use CoreDNS. Mapping a hostname does not create a working backend.
Traefik also listens on 443; certificates are not configured for these HTTP routes.
